value.name: notices phone silence
value.description: Asha sees that Devin has not replied again, and the silence on her phone mirrors the silence she has chosen by not answering earlier.
evidence: she finally turned the phone face up and saw that Devin had not written again after the three words at five forty-three; the silence on the screen was the same silence she had bought by not stepping into the stairwell

value.name: drives to Devin's apartment
value.description: Asha drives east toward Devin's apartment instead of calling him from the car.
evidence: She drove east toward his apartment on Spring Garden rather than calling from the car

value.name: decides to speak in person
value.description: Asha resolves that what she needs to tell Devin about the Monday timeline and her missed call cannot be said over the phone while driving.
evidence: because what she had to say to him about the Monday timeline and about the call she had chosen not to return was not something she was going to deliver through a speaker while merging

value.name: realizes ethics intake deadline
value.description: While driving, Asha remembers that the firm's ethics intake opens at eight, giving her about forty minutes before someone reaches Devin's phone.
evidence: it occurred to her that the firm's ethics intake opened at eight, which gave her roughly forty minutes to reach his door before someone there reached his phone

value.name: refuses to speed
value.description: Asha deliberately does not speed up, wanting to avoid arriving breathless and looking coordinated.
evidence: and she did not speed up, because arriving out of breath would look like exactly the kind of coordination she had spent the last hour refusing to attempt

value.name: parks near Devin's building
value.description: Asha finds a parking space near Devin's building and turns off the engine.
evidence: Asha found a space half a block from Devin's building and cut the engine
value.location_hint: near Devin's building on Spring Garden

value.name: composes herself before climbing stairs
value.description: Asha stays in the car briefly, breathing until her pulse settles enough for her to go upstairs.
evidence: for a moment she stayed with both hands on the wheel, counting the breaths it took to bring her pulse down to something she could carry up a flight of stairs

value.name: walks to the vestibule with briefcase
value.description: Asha carries her briefcase loosely as she walks to Devin's building, trying not to look like she has come to argue.
evidence: The briefcase rode in her left hand on the walk over, loose at her side rather than tucked against her ribs, because she did not want to arrive looking like she had come to argue a position

value.name: buzzes Devin's apartment
value.description: At the vestibule, Asha presses the buzzer for Devin's apartment and waits.
evidence: At the vestibule she pressed the buzzer for 3B and waited
